parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.location, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.reminder_sent, a.conversation_id, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.id as contact_id, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name FROM appointments a JOIN contacts c ON a.contact_id = c.id JOIN businesses b ON b.id = c.business_id WHERE a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed') AND a.starts_at > NOW() AND a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours' AND (a.reminder_sent = false OR a.reminder_sent IS NULL) ORDER BY a.starts_at ASC LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, created_at, updated_at) SELECT $1::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW() RETURNING id;
UPDATE appointments SET reminder_sent = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('appointment', $1::uuid, 'reminder_sent', 'system', 'automation', $2, jsonb_build_object('reminder_type', $3), jsonb_build_object('appointment_title', $4, 'contact_id', $5::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;
